DOMINION OF CANADA

SCHEDULE OF INDIAN RESERVES

IN THE DOMINION

SUPPLEMENT TO ANNUAL REPORT

OF THE

DEPARTMENT OF INDIAN AFFAIRS

FOR THE

YEAR ENDED JUNE 30

1902

OTTAWA

PRINTED BY S.E. DAWSON, PRINTER TO THE KING'S MOST

EXCELLENT MAJESTY

1902
